_comment: Workshop-only static credentials for src.security.auth.StaticWorkshopAuthorizer. These are NOT real secrets and MUST NOT be reused in any real deployment. A real deployment overrides this entirely via the REVIEWER_API_KEYS environment variable (comma-separated) or replaces StaticWorkshopAuthorizer with an Authorizer backed by a real identity provider -- no caller of src.security.auth.authorize() needs to change either way.
